record.question: She is not careful, so she often makes mistakes.
options: If she is careful, she will not make mistakes.
If she was careful, she would not make mistakes.
If she were careful, she would not make mistakes.
If she had been careful, she would not make mistakes.
record.explanation: The base sentence 'She is not careful, so she often makes mistakes' is a present-tense condition, so it needs a second conditional. Option 3, 'If she were careful, she would not make mistakes', uses the correct past subjunctive 'were' and 'would' in the main clause.
